title.zh-CN: 便血便秘与直肠肿块 · 29岁女性
title.en: Rectal bleeding, constipation and a rectal mass · woman aged 29

summary.zh-CN: 年轻患者有近梗阻直肠病变及肝脏占位，需要病理、分期和可切除性联合评估。
summary.en: A young patient has a near-obstructing rectal lesion and liver mass requiring tissue, staging and resectability assessment.

text.zh-CN: 患者最初未接受手术，后进展伴梗阻及左附件脓肿，行急诊直肠切除和双附件切除；随后切除肝转移灶，完成后续化疗。报告终点未发现复发或转移，但缺确切随访长度。
text.en: Initial surgery was declined; progression with obstruction and a left adnexal abscess led to emergency rectal and bilateral adnexal surgery. Liver metastasis was later resected with further chemotherapy. No recurrence/metastasis was reported at an endpoint of unspecified duration.

text.zh-CN: 有肝转移就永不考虑局部治疗

feedback.zh-CN: 需评估分布、反应与可切除性，而非一刀切。
feedback.en: Distribution, response and resectability need individual assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？

feedback.zh-CN: 影像缩小仍需局部治疗与系统病情复核。

text.zh-CN: CEA下降即可宣布治愈

feedback.zh-CN: 标志物不能代替完整肿瘤评估。

feedback.zh-CN: 扩展RAS及MMR/MSI等未记录，不能补写。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：整合组织与影像形成转移性肿瘤判断。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：完整RAS、MMR/MSI、遗传咨询、初始拒绝手术原因和确切随访长度。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Integrate histology and imaging to assess metastatic disease. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Full RAS, MMR/MSI, genetic counselling, reasons for declining initial surgery and exact follow-up duration. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 病例体现转化治疗后的反复可切除性评估及患者沟通，不能将短期终点等同长期治愈。
conclusion.en: The case illustrates repeated resectability assessment and communication after conversion therapy; short follow-up does not establish cure.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

testUtterances.text: 便血持续多长时间了？
How long have you noticed rectal bleeding?

是不是越来越难排便？
Has passing stool become difficult?
